en_quote: FATF Recommendations 9 to 23 seek to ensure the effectiveness of member jurisdictions' measures to detect and prevent illicit financial activities.
knowledge_zh: FATF建议9至23旨在确保成员国有效检测和预防非法金融活动

en_quote: Recommendation 9 advises jurisdictions to ensure that financial institution secrecy laws do not inhibit the implementation of FATF Recommendations.
knowledge_zh: FATF建议9要求金融机构保密法不得阻碍FATF建议的实施

en_quote: Recommendations 10 and 11 require financial institutions to conduct CDD when initiating business relationships, processing occasional transactions above a set threshold, suspecting money laundering or terrorist financing, or questioning the accuracy of previously obtained customer identification data.
knowledge_zh: FATF建议10和11规定客户尽职调查的触发情形

en_quote: Financial institutions should also retain transaction records and CDD information for at least five years to ensure timely compliance with requests from relevant authorities.
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应将交易记录和客户尽职调查信息保存至少五年

en_quote: Recommendations 12 to 16 provide additional measures for specific customers and activities.
knowledge_zh: FATF建议12至16针对特定客户和活动规定了额外措施

en_quote: For instance, financial institutions should identify PEPs, obtain senior management approval to establish a business relationship with a PEP, and verify their sources of wealth and funds.
knowledge_zh: 金融机构需识别政治敏感人物并验证其财富和资金来源

en_quote: Financial institutions should assess respondent institutions’ AML/CFT controls before initiating a correspondent relationship.
knowledge_zh: 金融机构在建立代理行关系前应评估代理行的反洗钱/反恐怖融资管控措施

en_quote: Money or value transfer service providers should be licensed and monitored.
knowledge_zh: 货币或价值转移服务提供商须获得许可并接受监管

en_quote: Financial institutions should assess risks from new technologies and ensure accurate originator and beneficiary data in wire transfers.
knowledge_zh: 金融机构需评估新技术风险并确保电汇中发端人和受益人数据准确

en_quote: Recommendations 17 to 19 advise jurisdictions to allow financial institutions to rely on third-party CDD if it meets certain criteria.
knowledge_zh: FATF建议17-19允许金融机构在满足条件时依赖第三方客户尽职调查

en_quote: Financial institutions should implement AML/CFT programs, facilitate the sharing of information for AML/CFT purposes, and apply enhanced due diligence to business relationships and transactions with persons and institutions from jurisdictions FATF identifies as higher risk.
knowledge_zh: 金融机构应实施反洗钱/反恐怖融资计划并对高风险辖区强化尽职调查

en_quote: Recommendations 20 to 23 discuss the obligation to report suspicious transactions. Financial institutions should report suspicious transactions to the relevant Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
knowledge_zh: 金融机构有义务向金融情报机构报告可疑交易

en_quote: Laws should protect financial institutions and their employees from liability and prohibit them from disclosing suspicious transactions.
knowledge_zh: 法律应保护金融机构及其员工免于责任并禁止披露可疑交易

en_quote: Designated nonfinancial businesses and professions (DNFBP) should implement internal controls, report suspicious transactions, and be subject to regulatory and supervisory measures to ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements.
knowledge_zh: 指定非金融行业和职业需实施内部控制、报告可疑交易并接受监管
